response.query: What SEIPS-guided sampling and qualitative-analytic strategies will maximize root-cause insights and generalizability from human-factors observations?
response.answer: To maximize root-cause insights and generalizability from human-factors observations, use SEIPS-guided purposive sampling and thematic analysis. Focus on diverse work settings and personnel to enhance generalizability. Employ iterative data collection and triangulation for deeper insights.
